            Purpose:          This bulletin rescinds 28 past Technical Policy and Procedure Notices (TPPNs) that are no
                              longer applicable.

            Subjects:         Technical Policy and Procedure Notice, rescind; TPPN, rescind


The Department of Buildings is now in the process of reviewing various Technical, Operational, Legal
and Administrative Policy and Procedure Notifications, and various published memoranda, directives,
and letters. Changes are necessary to reflect current Department of Buildings practice and update
procedures to reference amended rules and regulations. The Department is rescinding documents
that are obsolete as a result of more recent laws and rules.

Provided below is a partial list of documents to be rescinded in this Bulletin. Because the process is
ongoing, documents not specifically called out as rescinded in this Bulletin may still be rescinded in
future Buildings Bulletins.

This Buildings Bulletin rescinds specifically the following Technical Policy Procedure Notices (TPPN):

TPPN - 1/87, 4/87, 5/87, 6/87, 7/87, 3/88, 4/88, 16/88, 17/88, 18/88, 2/89, 4/91 (issued 6/25/1991), 4/91
(issued 7/26/1991), 2/92, 4/92, 10/92, 5/93, 8/93, 14/93, 1/94, 4/94, 10/94, 12/94, 2/95, 3/95, 4/95, 1/96,
and 1/00.

Rescinded TPPNs and other Policy and Procedure Notices can be accessed online at:
http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/bulletin_ppn_memo.shtml
